name: Extra Wagons
body:
Your caravan can handle more wagons than normal.

Prerequisite: Mobility 3

Benefit: Your caravan’s maximum number of wagons increases by two.

Normal: A caravan can have up to five wagons in it at any one time.

Special: You can gain this feat up to three times. Its effects stack.
